title: Second Chances
content:
The café slowly grew quiet after Yagnesh walked away.

Sneha watched him leave before turning toward Shreya.

For a few moments...

Neither of them spoke.

Both of them understood exactly what had happened.

Yagnesh knew Siddu's past.

To him...

Shreya was still the woman who had broken his best friend's heart.

Sneha opened her mouth, wanting to explain everything.

"Shreya... actually—"

But Shreya gently raised her hand, stopping her.

"It's alright, Sneha."

A faint smile appeared on her face.

"I don't blame him."

"If I were in his place..."

"I might have reacted the same way."

Her smile remained, but sadness lingered behind it.

"I can't expect people to trust me so easily."

"I lost that right the day I betrayed Siddu."

Sneha looked at her silently.

She could see the regret in Shreya's eyes.

The confident woman sitting before her was no longer the carefree girl she had once been.

Life had changed her.

Wanting to lighten the atmosphere, Sneha smiled gently.

"Let's forget about that for now."

"I wanted to ask you something."

Shreya looked at her.

"Do you know why Siddu suddenly went to India?"

Shreya shook her head.

"I don't know the exact reason."

"But I heard he went to Shimla to meet one of his close friends."

Sneha's eyes immediately brightened.

"I think it's Yashwanth."

Shreya looked at her curiously.

"Yashwanth?"

"Who is he?"

"How do you know him?"

A warm smile appeared on Sneha's face as old memories returned.

"He's Siddu's closest friend from engineering."

"When Siddu and I visited Shimla years ago, he introduced Yashwanth to me."

"During Siddu's darkest days, Yashwanth was the only one who truly understood him and stood by his side."

"To Siddu..."

"He's more like a brother than a friend."

Shreya listened quietly.

A small smile appeared on her face.

"Then Siddu must care about him a lot."

"He left his company in France and flew all the way to India just to meet him."

Sneha laughed softly.

"That's exactly who Siddu is."

"No matter how successful he becomes..."

"He never forgets the people who stood beside him."

Shreya gazed through the café window.

"So, some things never change..."

Sneha smiled.

"No."

"They never do."

After finishing their coffee, the two of them stepped outside.

The cool evening breeze swept through the streets of Paris as they exchanged a warm goodbye and returned to their respective hotels.

________________________________________

Meanwhile...

Sneha couldn't stop thinking about what had happened in the café.

She knew Yagnesh well.

His heart was kind.

He had reacted that way only because he cared deeply about Siddu.

Without wasting another moment, she walked toward Yagnesh's hotel room and knocked on the door.

A few moments later, the door opened.

The moment he saw Sneha, he lowered his head.

"I'm sorry."

"My behaviour at the café..."

"I was completely out of my mind."

Sneha smiled reassuringly.

"It's okay, Yagnesh."

"I know why you reacted like that."

"But there's something you should know."

He looked at her attentively.

Sneha took a slow breath before beginning.

"After Shreya betrayed Siddu..."

"Soon after, life betrayed her as well."

"Only then did she truly understand how painful betrayal can be."

"From that day onward..."

"She wanted to become a better person and make amends for her mistakes."

"But no one was willing to give her another chance."

Yagnesh remained silent.

Sneha continued,

"Do you know why she's helping me?"

"She believes that helping Siddu and me find happiness is the only way she can make peace with her past."

"She has supported me more than anyone else."

"The Shreya you met today..."

"Isn't the same Shreya who hurt Siddu five years ago."

"She's matured."

"She's kind."

"And every single day..."

"She carries the weight of her past."

Yagnesh slowly lowered his eyes.

He replayed their brief meeting at the café.

Now he understood the sadness hidden behind her smile.

After a long silence, he let out a quiet sigh.

"I judged her without knowing who she has become."

"I think..."

"I've made the same mistake everyone else is making."

He looked at Sneha.

"If she has truly changed..."

"Then I owe her an apology."

A gentle smile spread across Sneha's face.

"I knew you'd understand."

Yagnesh smiled back.

"Can you send me Shreya's number?"

"I'd like to apologize to her personally."

Sneha nodded happily.

"Of course."

She immediately shared Shreya's contact with him.

As Yagnesh looked at the number on his phone, neither of them realized that fate had quietly begun weaving another unexpected bond.

Sometimes...

Life gives people a second chance...

Not to erase their past...

But to prove they are no longer the person they once were.

And without realizing it...

Fate had just taken the first step toward writing another unexpected story.
